hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); TOOL=$(printf %s "$INPUT" | grep -o '"tool_name"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[^"]*"' | head -1 | sed 's/.*"\([^"]*\)"$/\1/'); case "$TOOL" in Edit|Write|NotebookEdit|MultiEdit|Bash) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; if [ "$TOOL" = "Bash" ]; then TARGET=$(printf %s "$INPUT" | grep -o '"command"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[^"]*"' | head -1); else TARGET=$(printf %s "$INPUT" | grep -o '"\(file_path\|notebook_path\)"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[^"]*"' | head -1); fi; [ -z "$TARGET" ] && exit 0; PROTECTED='src/config/constants\.ts|src/modules/ai/|src/composables/use-image-recognition\.ts|src/views/feedback\.vue|src/modules/feedback/|src/modules/auth/email-service\.ts|(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_.-])test/|CLAUDE\.md|\.claude/'; if ! printf %s "$TARGET" | grep -Eq "$PROTECTED"; then exit 0; fi; if [ "$TOOL" = "Bash" ]; then printf %s "$TARGET" | grep -Eq '(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_-])(sed[[:space:]]+-[a-zA-Z]*i|perl[[:space:]]+-[a-zA-Z]*i|tee|truncate|dd|shred)([[:space:]]|$)|>[[:space:]]*[^|&]*[A-Za-z]|(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_-])(rm|mv|cp)([[:space:]])' || exit 0; fi; printf %s '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"该文件属于禁改清单（图像识别 / 问题反馈 / 密钥常量 / 测试流程），改动会导致功能静默失效。请先告诉用户，由用户决定；测试失败请修改业务代码，不要改 test/。详见 CLAUDE.md。"}}'
hooks.statusMessage: 检查是否触碰禁改文件
